result.rationale: The new handler apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts calls appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) (throwing ZodError on bad input) and JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")) with no try/catch, and never checks req.method — all visible in the diff. Malformed/undecryptable payloads or GET requests will surface as unhandled 500s rather than 4xx, a real behavioral defect in the newly added endpoint.

judged_text: The handler validates input with throwing APIs inside no try/catch — appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) throws ZodError on malformed bodies and JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...)) throws on undecryptable or non-JSON payloads — and it never checks req.method. The parent application sending a malformed, wrongly-encrypted, or non-JSON payload (or a GET request) gets an opaque Next.js 500 with a stack trace instead of a 4xx, leaving no error contract for the operator to debug why credential sync failed.
